description: Read Proofpoint Targeted Attack Protection: threat messages and malicious clicks, campaigns, forensics, Very Attacked People and top clickers, decode rewritten links, and start workflows when a threat is delivered or a malicious link is clicked.

proofpoint_click_blocked_trigger.description: Runs each time someone clicks a malicious link and Proofpoint blocks it. Ones from before the workflow is turned on don't start it. It checks every 10 minutes at most, to keep within Proofpoint's daily limit.

output.campaign_id: The threat's campaign, if any, for 'Get campaign'.
output.classification: The threat's class, such as phish or malware.
output.click: The whole event as Proofpoint gives it.
output.click_ip: The IP address it was clicked from.
output.message_guid: The id of the message the link was in.
output.recipient: The email address of the person who clicked.
output.sender: The message's sender (the user part is hashed).
output.threat_id: The threat's id, for 'Get threat' and 'Get forensics'.
output.threat_status: The threat's status: active, cleared or falsePositive.
output.threat_url: The threat's page in the TAP Dashboard.
output.url: The malicious link that was clicked.

proofpoint_click_permitted_trigger.description: Runs each time someone clicks a malicious link and Proofpoint lets the click through. Ones from before the workflow is turned on don't start it. It checks every 10 minutes at most, to keep within Proofpoint's daily limit.

output.campaign_id: The threat's campaign, if any, for 'Get campaign'.
output.classification: The threat's class, such as phish or malware.
output.click: The whole event as Proofpoint gives it.
output.click_ip: The IP address it was clicked from.
output.message_guid: The id of the message the link was in.
output.recipient: The email address of the person who clicked.
output.sender: The message's sender (the user part is hashed).
output.threat_id: The threat's id, for 'Get threat' and 'Get forensics'.
output.threat_status: The threat's status: active, cleared or falsePositive.
output.threat_url: The threat's page in the TAP Dashboard.
output.url: The malicious link that was clicked.

proofpoint_new_campaign_trigger.description: Runs for each threat campaign Proofpoint sees aimed at your organization for the first time, with its id for 'Get campaign'. Campaigns already active when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It checks every two hours at most, to keep within Proofpoint's limit of 50 a day.

output.campaign_id: The campaign's id, for 'Get campaign' and 'Get forensics'.
output.notable: True if Proofpoint marked it notable.
output.vertically_targeted: True if it targets an industry.

proofpoint_new_top_clicker_trigger.description: Runs each time someone joins your top clickers (the people who clicked the most malicious links over the last 30 days), including someone who comes back. People already on it when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It checks every six hours at most.

output.click_count: How many malicious links they clicked in the last 30 days.
output.families: Their clicks in each threat family.
output.name: Their name, if known.
output.title: Their job title, if known.
output.vip: True if they are marked as a VIP.

proofpoint_new_very_attacked_person_trig.description: Runs each time someone joins your Very Attacked People over the last 30 days, including someone who left the list and comes back. People already on it when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It checks every six hours at most.

output.attack_index: Their attack index over the last 30 days.
output.families: Their score in each threat family.
output.name: Their name, if known.
output.title: Their job title, if known.
output.vip: True if they are marked as a VIP.

proofpoint_threat_blocked_trigger.description: Runs for each message with a known threat that Proofpoint blocked or quarantined. Ones from before the workflow is turned on don't start it. It checks every 10 minutes at most, to keep within Proofpoint's daily limit.

output.campaign_id: The first threat's campaign, if any, for 'Get campaign'.
output.classification: The first threat's class, such as phish or malware.
output.message: The whole event as Proofpoint gives it, with every threat.
output.message_time: When it was delivered or blocked.
output.quarantine_folder: The quarantine folder, for a blocked message.
output.subject: The subject line.
output.threat: The first threat: a link, an attachment's hash or an address.
output.threat_id: The first threat's id, for 'Get threat' and 'Get forensics'.
output.threat_ids: The ids of every threat in the message.
output.threat_type: The first threat's type: url, attachment or messageText.
output.threat_url: The first threat's page in the TAP Dashboard.

parameters.description: Only messages with this kind of threat: url, attachment or messageText. Leave empty for all.
